description: Source code for WebSocket handshake stream base class, including validation and header handling functions within the Chromium project.

classes.name: WebSocketHandshakeStreamBase
classes.description: Base class for handling WebSocket handshake stream, including validation of headers and extensions.

methods.name: MultipleHeaderValuesMessage
methods.description: Returns an error message indicating a header appears multiple times.

methods.name: AddVectorHeaderIfNonEmpty
methods.description: Adds a header with comma-joined values if the vector is not empty.

methods.name: ValidateSubProtocol
methods.description: Validates the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header against requested protocols.

methods.name: ValidateExtensions
methods.description: Validates WebSocket extensions in the response headers.

methods.name: RecordHandshakeResult
methods.description: Records the result of the WebSocket handshake for metrics.
